stem: Meera sets up three similar money plant saplings at her home in Jaipur for a school science project. Pot 1 is kept in sunlight and watered every day. Pot 2 is kept in sunlight but is never watered. Pot 3 is watered every day but kept in a dark cupboard. After three weeks, which result should Meera expect, and what does it show?

options.text: Pot 2 grows best, because sunlight alone is enough for a plant to grow well
Pot 3 grows best, because regular watering alone makes plants grow well
Pot 1 grows best, because a plant grows best when it gets both sunlight and adequate water together
All three pots grow equally well, because sunlight and water each work in the same way

teacher.key_rationale: Pot 1 receives both sunlight and adequate water, so it grows best; Pot 2 lacks water (reduced growth or death) and Pot 3 lacks sunlight (reduced growth despite watering). This matches the target decision that both conditions together, not either one alone, give best growth.
